ticket.title: Add XHigh and Max to the ReasoningEffort wire contract
ticket.description: gaugeblock_contracts::ReasoningEffort has None/Low/Medium/High; models-catalog models advertise up to xhigh and max (measured on cline-pass models via the curated overlay). Until the contract grows, sawhorse cannot request those tiers even though the provider accepts them - the gateway clamps rather than rejects, verified across all six values when SH-9 was investigated. This is a wire-contract change: serde naming in common/crates/gaugeblock-contracts/src/sawhorse.rs, CONTRACTS.md, and the miter contracts gate. Filed separately from GB-217 so the adoption there is not blocked on a contract bump.

verification_receipt.summary: ReasoningEffort now carries XHigh and Max, completing the closed six-tier set that models-catalog defines (None/Low/Medium/High/XHigh/Max, ranks 0-5). Confirmed from the crate source that the set is closed: upstream reasoning_options folds onto those ranks (minimal->Low, med->Medium, xhigh->XHigh, maximum->Max) and unknown tokens are dropped, so an open Other(String) variant would only move the mismatch. XHigh carries an explicit serde rename to the canonical wire string xhigh, with a test proving the snake_case spelling x_high does not silently parse; all six round-trip and unknown tokens are rejected. CONTRACTS.md mirrors the enum and sawhorse payload emits the two new tiers verbatim. Gates: gaugeblock-contracts 31 tests, sawhorse-core 21 tests, clippy and fmt green in both.
